responsibility: DataTransfer production lifecycle, isolated configuration consumer and directly affected tests

production_change.behavior: Cancel and observe application workers concurrently with service shutdown; track HTTP/gRPC serving goroutines separately; after the existing five-second graceful deadline, force-stop gRPC and observe service completion. A completed worker group takes precedence over an already-expired shutdown context; an unfinished group still reports worker shutdown: context deadline exceeded.
production_change.confirmed_trigger: A gRPC subscriber uses 64 KiB static connection/stream windows and stops reading while a connector sends 256 KiB telemetry messages. GracefulStop waits for the blocked SendMsg; application connector/journal workers have already stopped.

isolated_consumer_change.scope: The isolated adapter consumes configuration through production gRPC, ConfigManager, connector Manager and application journal. Its adapter opens no field-device connections.
